statement: The NMT v2 is the current version of the template, with symmetric and asymmetric variants and multiple resolutions.
Quality control includes visual inspection of brain masks and surfaces for accuracy.
The N3 spline distance should be empirically determined to ensure uniform gray and white matter intensities.
The pipeline is not validated for species other than macaques; adaptations for other primates would require appropriate length scales and templates.
The NMT v2 is the current version; the paper describes NMT v1.2, so users should be aware of version differences.
The pipeline may require manual intervention for custom brain masks in rare registration failures.
Input data must be in BIDS format, with T1w and T2w images expected.
T1 weighted images are expected with the _T1w BIDS extension.
T2 weighted images are expected with the _T2w BIDS extension.
All files with the same extension (T1w or T2w) will be aligned to the first one and averaged.
The -data parameter must point to an existing BIDS format directory.
The -out parameter must point to an existing output path.
The -soft parameter must be either SPM or ANTS, with SPM requiring a specific version of macapype/skullTo3d not available by default.
Either -params or -species must be provided; -params is mandatory if -species is omitted, and vice versa.
The -test option can be used to check if the full pipeline is coherent, generating only graph.dot and graph.png.
The -prep option performs only data preparation, without brain extraction and segmentation.
The -noseg option performs data preparation and brain extraction, but no segmentation.
The _4animal option uses bet4animal (FSL) for brain extraction, for faster computation; by default atlas_brex is used.
The marmoT2 species option can be used for segmenting from the T2w image; by default, T1w is used for marmo.
